rule.title: Server-First Components in Next.js App Router
rule.statement: React components in the Next.js App Router must be React Server Components (RSC) by default. The 'use client' directive must only be applied at leaf interactive components.
rule.rationale: Applying 'use client' at high levels inflates JavaScript client bundles, degrades first contentful paint (FCP), and breaks server streaming advantages.
rule.implementation_guidance: Keep layouts and data-fetching pages as Server Components. Extract buttons, inputs, and modals into leaf Client Components.

forbidden.example: Placing 'use client' at the very top of app/documents/page.tsx.

preferred.example: page.tsx (Server Component fetching doc) -> imports <DocumentTable /> (Server) -> imports <DeleteButton /> ('use client')

source.evidence_quote: Default to Server Components to reduce bundle size and leverage streaming. Push the 'use client' boundary down to the leaves of your component tree.
